sources.locator: Annex 7 opening narrative, PDF file p. 109 (printed p. 107)
sources.quote: DPRK IT workers affiliated with KMCTC used Chinese nationals as banking proxies in order to launder illicit funds generated from the DPRK IT workers' revenue generation efforts in China.

notes: Organization/delegation-level MSMT context only; it does not attribute personal banking-proxy use, money laundering, account control, or a transaction to this individual.

identity_boundary: Kim Myong Chol is the person named in the MSMT Annex 7 KMCTC employment table. Giang, John, Julian, and Luan are source-reported employment labels; the cited table supplies no civil identity, separate-person finding, or present-account finding. The same-name records involving the OFAC-listed SEK Studio representative and the Oh Chung Song-associated Dubai/Vientiane group remain separate until a source explicitly connects them to the KMCTC worker.
